study_notes.site12_pilot: 2026-10-24 Site 12 pilot: each front lower window is aligned with its upper window's outer edge (the side away from the entry) and widened toward the photographed 1.9 m, stopping 0.06 m short of the entry door, as measured at fitted cameras on Keppler 1109 (Apr 2019 pano 9T6FszoANzyG-g8_D8NI8Q) and Hutchins 1114 (Apr 2019 pano I2Dk_vOGXwebdfpTi5JLzg): lower widths 1.72-2.0 m with outer edges within 0.1 m of the upper's. Before, the lowers were 1.75 m centred 1.0 m off, overhanging the upper's edge by 0.43 m. The entries stay at their stations (about 0.28 m off the photos), which caps the widths; uppers, screens and materials unchanged.
